reviews.body:
Thank you for the contribution.

I’d generally suggest to reuse `percent-encoding` (which is already in our dependency stack due to `url`) for readability and completeness.

Im also not sure if the escpae list is complete or contains everything necessary for nix. e.g. `^` and `’` should probably also be escaped.

Mind i rebased your PR against current main, and fixed some test results.

Thanks!
just updated the Cargo.nix after updating the workspace.
this should go out with the next release next tuesday.

comments.body:
Replaced the handwritten encoder with percent-encoding and retained only path separators and URI-unreserved characters literally. The tests now also cover caret, straight and curly apostrophes, and UTF-8 paths. These commits are on top of your rebased branch and preserve your test changes. All four focused helper tests pass, including punctuation and UTF-8.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
